name: Wow! Wow! Wubbzy!
description: Happy-go-lucky Wubbzy bounces his way into wacky, fun-filled adventures in the town of Wuzzleburg with his best friends: inventor Widget, book-smart Walden, and sweet-as-can-be Daizy.

videos.title: Wubbzy's Big Movie!
videos.overview: Wubbzy, Widget and Walden are going to get some doodleberry pie, but Wubbzy ends up tripping over a rock, smashes his head, down a hill and ends up getting Knockity-Noggin and being unable to remember who he is. Widget and Walden try help Wubbzy recover his memory, but fail miserably.

videos.title: A Little Help From My Friends
Wubbzy Goes Boo!
videos.overview: The irrepressibly enthusiastic Wubbzy and his pals Widgit, Walden, and Daisy welcome fall in Wuzzleburg as a time for celebrations, dressing up, and a healthy dose of spookiness. Like most preschoolers, Wubbzy and his friends have conflicting feelings about scaring people and being scared--sometimes it's fun, and sometimes it's just plain scary. Wubbzy loves scary movies, but watching before bedtime keeps him awake in "Monster Madness." Even with Widgit's inventive monster mashing machine and lots of reassurance from his friends, Wubbzy has a hard time overcoming his fears and getting a good night's sleep. It's Wubbzy that's intent on doing the scaring in "The Ghost of Wuzzleburg," but it seems that he's not the scariest creature at the local Halloween party. In "March of the Pumpkins," Wubbzy has to overcome his fears and some creepy local legends in order to win the fall festival pumpkin contest and earn a spot at the head of the march of the pumpkins parade. Walden teaches Wubbzy and Widgit a lesson about patience when he forgoes playing in an enormous leaf pile to wait for the last leaf to fall in "The Last Leaf," Wubbzy learns firsthand the perils of acting impulsively when he plays with Moo Moo's magic wand without permission and the magic gets wildly out of control, and flexibility is the key to enjoying the day when Walden's efforts to plan the perfect tea party don't go quite as planned in "Tea for Three." Each of these six Wubbzy episodes features fun, curiosity, friendship, and a wholesome message for young viewers

videos.title: Widget's Wild Ride
videos.overview: Today is the big Wuzzleburg Derby, and Wubbzy's car is run-down. So, Widget repairs it up with the right tools and makes it extravagant.

videos.title: Attack of the 50-Foot Fleegle
videos.overview: Wubbzy adopts a fleegle and he feeds him candy instead of the right kinds of food, and it is a big problem – a literally big problem. The Fleegle grows to a massive size, transforms into a monster and causes destruction to Wuzzleburg.

videos.title: A Tale of Tails
videos.overview: Everyone refuses to play Kickety-Kickball along with Wubbzy because of his long and bendy tail, but soon, after learning from his friends, he realizes his tail is kooky and cool.

videos.title: Special Delivery
videos.overview: Wubbzy watches a package that belongs to Walden, who is not home, and is really tempted to see what is inside. Unfortunately, he opens it, figure it out it is a train set, and soon, breaks it!

videos.title: Wubbzy in the Woods
videos.overview: Wubbzy gets lost on the way to the frog pond, feeling he does not need a map.

videos.title: A Little Help From Your Friends
videos.overview: Widget has always wanted to be a ballerina, but can she make it.  Wubbzy starts a new club for all of his friends.  He calls it the "Wubb Club."

videos.title: Goo Goo Grief!
videos.overview: Walden finds a strange elephant-like creature on his lawn, who likes his Hoopty-Horn.

videos.title: Perfecto Party
videos.overview: Walden wants to make a marshmallow lasagna for Wubbzy's birthday party, but marshmallows are not in season.

videos.title: A Clean Sweep
videos.overview: It is cleanup day but Wubbzy does not think it is fun, so he procrastinates. Soon, his friends show them that cleaning up can be fun.

videos.title: Mr. Cool
videos.overview: Walden unleashes his alter ego when the Wuzzleburg Boogie Bash is coming.

videos.title: Wuzzleburg Express
videos.overview: The gang is going on a picnic at Mount Zubba Bubba. Unfortunately, when the train goes berserk on the way to the mountain, Widget tries to make the Wuzzleburg Express work again.

videos.title: Gidget the Super Robot
videos.overview: Widget is jealous when she thinks Wubbzy and Walden are spending more time with Gidget, her lookalike robot, than her.

videos.title: Gotta Dance
videos.overview: Widget wants to become a ballerina but she is not that good. So, she cheats and creates a machine to help her dance.

videos.title: The Wubb Club
videos.overview: Wubbzy creates a club and soon, Widget and Walden build a huge clubhouse for it. Problems arise when the beavers chew on its poles and make it a non-safery-place.

videos.title: Eggs Over Easy
videos.overview: Today is Easter so Widget offers to help Wubbzy decorate the Easter eggs with her new machine. Problems arise when the machine breaks.

videos.title: The Flight of the Flutterfly
videos.overview: Wubbzy wants to keep a yellow Flutterfly with pink polka-dots named Norm, so Widget builds a house for it.

videos.title: Warp Speed Wubbzy!
videos.overview: Wubbzy and Widget dress up as spacemen after Walden sees a light that looks like a spaceship.

videos.title: Wubbzy the Star
videos.overview: Wubbzy wants to be the star in Walden's play. but no one can hear him because he does not speak loudly enough. Widget tries making an invention, but when it malfunctions, what will Wubbzy do in the play?

videos.title: Who Needs School?
videos.overview: Wubbzy is afraid to go to school after being convinced by Buggy, Huggy and Earl that it is scary.

videos.title: Magic Tricks
videos.overview: Wubbzy and his friends learn magic tricks from Moo-Moo, but Wubbzy is having a hard time doing tricks and he gets frustrated and feels like to quit, but he has to keep trying.

videos.title: Monster Madness
videos.overview: Wubbzy stays up late watching scary movies and believes he sees the monsters from the movies in real life.

videos.title: The Last Leaf
videos.overview: Walden waits for the last leaf from the Figgity-Fig tree to fall. When Wubbzy and Widget come back they find Walden taking a nap. When the leaf falls Wubbzy and Widget try to catch it before Walden wakes up.

videos.title: Dash for Dolly
videos.overview: Wubbzy and Walden buy a Hammerin' Holly Dolly for Widget's birthday party, but it is a rare find.

videos.title: Watch the Birdie
videos.overview: Wubbzy figure it out that Birdy Bird has stolen some of his belongings for her nest.

videos.title: Wubbzy Tells a Whopper
videos.overview: Wubbzy lies about a Growly Gus stealing Widget's Whammer-Hammer, but in reality, he broke it by accident.

videos.title: The Snow Shoo Shoo
videos.overview: Wubbzy, Widget and Walden search for the Snow Shoo-Shoo monster when they do not see it in its usual location on top of Mount Zubba Bubba.

videos.title: Pirate Treasure
videos.overview: The gang finds a treasure map in a library book. After finding no treasure, they soon realize they found the best treasure, an adventure.

videos.title: Escape From Dino Island
videos.overview: When Wubbzy wants to meet the dinosaurs on Dino Island, a Sillysaurus scares him.

videos.title: Widget Gets the Blooey Blues
videos.overview: Widget the rabbit’s new invention fails and she gets the bad case of depression.

videos.title: The Grass is Always Plaider
videos.overview: Wubbzy, Widget and Walden visit Plaidville after Wuzzleburg starts boring them, but when they go to Plaidville it starts to bore them and they learn Wuzzleburg is not a bad place after all.

videos.title: Everything's Coming Up Wubbzy
videos.overview: Wubbzy wishes everyone was more like him so Widget builds a hypnotizing hat that causes town members to act just like Wubbzy.

videos.title: Wubbzy's Magical Mess-Up
videos.overview: Wubbzy takes care of Moo-Moo's magic shop but causes trouble when he gets the magic words wrong constantly.

videos.title: Tea for Three
videos.overview: Wubbzy wants to throw a tea party with his friends but Walden insists it must be like his rule book says.

videos.title: Come Spy with Me
videos.overview: After Walden acts suspicious, Wubbzy and Widget try to spy on him.

videos.title: Puddle Muddle
videos.overview: Today is picture day, but Wubbzy just cannot keep getting muddy. So, the 3 friends brainstorm creative solutions to Wubbzy's problem. When Wubbzy is going to enter to the photo studio, Miss Zamboni calls for help: Her parrot named Polly escaped from the cage. Wubbzy must save Polly from the tree.

videos.title: Mr. Valentine
videos.overview: Wubbzy delivers Valentine's Day cards when the mailman does not feel well.

videos.title: Wubbzy in the Middle
videos.overview: Widget and Walden get angry, argue and turn against each other after an accident with Widget's latest invention. Despite what happened, Wubbzy tries to get them back together.

videos.title: Mt. Fizzy Pop
videos.overview: Mt. Fizzy Pop on Dino Island is about to erupt sour milky-milk on the town of Wuzzleburg, so Wubbzy, Widget and Walden try to stop it.

videos.title: Zoo Hullabaloo
videos.overview: Wubbzy watches some of the zoo animals while Widget repairs their cages, but the animals cause problems in his house.

videos.title: The Super Fixers
videos.overview: Widget becomes obsessed with her favorite TV show when she builds a television set, the Video-Tron 3000, that has thirty screens, so Wubbzy and Walden try to get her away from it by acting like the characters.

videos.title: Fly Us to the Moon
videos.overview: Wubbzy, Widget and Walden wake up the Man on the Moon when he oversleeps and does not drive the moon across the sky.

videos.title: O' Figgety-Fig Tree
videos.overview: When Wubbzy, Widget and Walden decorate the Christmas figgety-fig tree, things go a little out of control.

videos.title: Snow Day
videos.overview: Wubbzy and Widget try to repair Walden's polar bear sculpture when Wubbzy crashes his sled into it.

videos.title: The Tired Tail
videos.overview: Wubbzy's tail loses its bounce and has to rest it if he wants his tail to get better. Unfortunately, he just cannot stay off his tail.

videos.title: Wubbzy's Big Idea
videos.overview: Wubbzy is tired of being small, and wants to be big. So, Widget builds an invention but things go wrong when Wubbzy gets too big.

videos.title: Where's My Wiggle Wrench?
videos.overview: Widget loses not only her lucky Wiggle-Wrench, first she builds the Super Stepper 3000 Then she builds the Super Sifter 3000 and she builds the Super Scooper 3000 but she did not look everywhere but her confidence as well. Unfortunately, it is right before the big construction contest.

videos.title: Follow the Leader
videos.overview: A group of baby chirpees have lost their mother, until they start to follow Wubbzy who leads them home.

videos.title: The Wubbzy Shuffle
videos.overview: Widget catches on to the fact that Wubbzy is winning all his games by cheating, so she builds an ultimate robot to teach him a lesson about cheating.

videos.title: Broken Record
videos.overview: Everyone seems to be in need of Wubbzy's help when he is trying to break a world record.

videos.title: Walden on the Beach
videos.overview: Nobody knows that Walden is afraid of the water, until they all head to the beach one afternoon.

videos.title: Who's That Girl?
videos.overview: Wubbzy makes a brand new friend, Daizy, who just moved into the neighborhood and wants to do girly activities with him. When a game of hide-and-seek unexpectedly takes Wubbzy to a kickety-kickball game, he realizes he misunderstood how to make good friends and make her feel welcome. Daizy makes new friends, Widget and Walden.

videos.title: Wubbzy's Big Move
videos.overview: Wubbzy decides to move to the Wubb Club, but on his first day living in the Wubb Club, everything goes haywire.

videos.title: Wubbzy and the Fire Engine
videos.overview: Widget builds Wubbzy a Fire Engine. Later, when Chef Fritz is making pancakes on the top of a building, Wubbzy and Daizy mistake it for a fire to put out and Wubbzy gets stuck on top of the building. Daizy then calls out for help from Walden, Widget and the firefighters. The wind picks up, the tower tilts and Wubbzy falls, but the firefighters can rescue him in time.

videos.title: Too Much of a Doodle Thing
videos.overview: Wubbzy likes doodleberries, but soon he eats all of them in Wuzzleburg. So he uses Daizy's magic grow spray to make more doodleberries...but then they start spreading and growing crazy all over Wuzzleburg!

videos.title: Wubbzy and the Sparkle Stone
videos.overview: Wubbzy, Widget and Walden venture to center of the earth to find for Daizy's glow-in-the-dark sparkle stone ring.

videos.title: Meet the Wuzzles
videos.overview: Wubbzy, Widget and Walden rehearse for a dance party at the Wubb Club. Daizy wants to join in but cannot play an instrument, and whenever she tries to tell Wubbzy what she can do, he gives her many chores instead. But when Wubbzy loses his voice after drinking all the lemonade, he and the others find Daizy, who sings very well. Daizy then jumps in and becomes the lead singer of the band.

videos.title: Bye Bye Birdies
videos.overview: When a flock of migrating La-Dee-Da Birds are drawn to the Wubb Club, Wubbzy and friends must find a way to draw them away before a snowstorm hits.

videos.title: Call of the Mild
videos.overview: Wubbzy and Daizy find a uni-horn and Daizy wants to keep it as pet but it gets lost and not to be found in Wuzzleburg.

videos.title: Tooth or Dare
videos.overview: Daizy loses a tooth, she wants to see the Tooth Fairy, but the Tooth Fairy is going on a trip to Gumdrop Mountain, so Wubbzy tries to fill in for her by dressing up as her and uses the WubbMobile to get to Daizy's house. But they met the Tooth Troll.

videos.title: Moo Moo's Snoozity Snooze
videos.overview: Moo Moo walks in his sleep, casting magic spells all over Wuzzleburg. Problems arise when Walden rides away on a train and Widget's clock flies away.

videos.title: Welcome to the Dollhouse
videos.overview: Wubbzy and Daizy use Widget's Shrinky-Dinky 3000 so they can play in Daizy's dollhouse but problems arise when they get lost.

videos.title: What Would Wubbzy Do?
videos.overview: After Widget and Walden go on a meteorological expedition, Daizy gets Wubbzy to deliver her jars of doodleberry jelly.

videos.title: Wubbzy the Hero
videos.overview: When Wubbzy plays chase with a dinosaur friend, the townspeople believe he has saved Wuzzleburg.

videos.title: The Nasty Nose
videos.overview: Wubbzy gets a case of "nasty nose," where his nose gets all swollen and polka-dotted. Can he show up at the pool party with a disguise on his embarrassing nose?

videos.title: Daizy's Hair Salon
videos.overview: Daizy wants to have a hair salon, but everyone has their hair done somewhere else in Wuzzleburg, so she ends up doing the hairstyles for animals.

videos.title: New Kid on the Block
videos.overview: A new kid named Murphy moves to Wuzzleburg and has more Captain Wonderpants merchandise than Wubbzy, making him jealous. But after getting Wubbzy's Blinky Beepy Boomerang from a tree, Murphy becomes a new pal of Wubbzy.

videos.title: The Ghost of Wuzzleburg
videos.overview: Wubbzy dresses up as a scary monster for the Halloween party in the Wubb Club, and scares everyone thinking he is a real monster.

videos.title: March of the Pumpkins
videos.overview: Wuzzleburg is having an autumn festival and Wubbzy is very determined to win with his pumpkin.

videos.title: Great and Grumpy Holiday
videos.overview: Wubbzy stops at nothing to get the perfect Christmas tree that is on Old Man Grumpus' land.

videos.title: The Super Special Gift
videos.overview: Wubbzy promises Daizy a super-special gift for Christmas, so he helps Santa deliver all the Christmas presents, including a rainbow for Daizy.

videos.title: Cupid's Little Helper
videos.overview: Wubbzy finds Cupid's bubble wand causing everyone to fall in love with each other. There is a twist because he does not know it belongs to Cupid, so he ends up creating odd couples all over Wuzzleburg...including a love triangle with him, Daizy, and a Great Grey Smellyphant.

videos.title: My Speedy Valentine
videos.overview: Wubbzy, Widget, Walden and Daizy need to create valentines quickly so they can give them to all their friends at the Valentine's Day party in time.

videos.title: Daizy's Favorite Place
videos.overview: Daizy takes her friends to the park for a picnic, but everyone believes the goats, Kickety-kick ball players, and buzzy bees are ruining her picnic.

videos.title: Quiet Wubbzy
videos.overview: Wubbzy finds a Woogle Bugle, but it makes a loud sound, so everyone asks him to be quiet. But when the Horrible Beasty Beast appears, intending to scare the townspeople and eat Wuzzleburg, Wubbzy uses the loud bugle to scare him away.

videos.title: Once Upon a Wubbzy
videos.overview: Daizy and Wubbzy ruin Widget's pickleberry bush by accident and then try to replace it before she finds out by visiting the forest.

videos.title: Big Birthday Mystery
videos.overview: Wubbzy tries to solve a puzzling mystery by using his new detective kit when everybody is gone in Wuzzleburg on his birthday party.

videos.title: Hangin' with Mr. Gummy
videos.overview: Wubbzy accidentally breaks Mr. Gummy's window and as an apology spends the day with him. He wants to play with his friends but soon learns to use his imagination.

videos.title: Wonder Wubbzy!
videos.overview: Wubbzy and Daizy play to be superheroes but believe they are not that super.

videos.title: Hoop Dreamz
videos.overview: Wubbzy befriends a professional hoopity hoop player named Jam-Jam James. When meeting Jam-Jam he feels he does not need his friends.

videos.title: Daizy's Purple Thumb
videos.overview: Mayor Whoozle commissions Daizy to attend to the Wuzzleburg garden, but she thinks she lost her gardening abilities with a purple thumb.

videos.title: Big Bunny Blues
videos.overview: When Easter is cancelled, Wubbzy and the gang visit to Easter Egg Island and meet Easter Bunny, who is overweight and cannot hop around to deliver the eggs.

videos.title: Flower Day Parade
videos.overview: Wubbzy wants to contribute to the Flower Day Parade.

videos.title: Save the Wuzzly
videos.overview: Wubbzy, Daizy, Widget and Walden must find a new place for the Wuzzly bears to live when their bamboo-boo trees get cut down for a playground.

videos.title: All Bottled Up
videos.overview: It is hot in Wuzzleburg today. Everyone in Wuzzleburg tries the new juice called Fizz-ee Wizz-ee Juice instead of water. But when Wuzzleburg becomes a bottle-filled wasteland, Wubbzy, Daizy, Widget and Walden come up with creative ways to reuse the juice bottles.

videos.title: Wubb Girlz Rule (1)
videos.overview: A popular girl group called the Wubb Girlz comes to Wuzzleburg. While Wubbzy shows them around, their fans, unfortunately, do not get to see them because they are having so much fun with their newest fan and friend, Wubbzy.

videos.title: Wuzzleburg Idol (2)
videos.overview: The Wubb Girlz are hosting a talent competition. While everyone tries to act just like them for the competition, Wubbzy decides to just be himself while participating in the Wuzzleburg Idol competition.

videos.title: Bye Bye Wuzzleburg (3)
videos.overview: Wubbzy confesses his fears about leaving Wuzzleburg that he's supposed to go to Wuzzlewood because he confesses that he's afraid to go to a new town.

videos.title: Wubbzy's Wacky Journey (4)
videos.overview: Walden refuses to let anyone stop at fun places along the drive to Wuzzlewood.

videos.title: Wubbzy's Big Makeover (5)
videos.overview: Wubbzy tries to adjust to his new star image as a hip-hop dancer named Wubb-Z.

videos.title: The Big Wuzzlewood Concert (6)
videos.overview: Wubbzy struggles with stage-fright when performing with the Wubb Girlz. To help their friend, Daizy, Widget and Walden try several things, from Walden's hypnosis to Widget's invention, the Wow Wow 3000, but nothing works, especially when Widget's invention was the fake Wubbzy. The real Wubbzy then gets told by the Wubb Girlz that performing together is the best way to conquer stage-fright.

videos.title: Lights, Camera, Wubbzy (7)
videos.overview: Wubbzy is offered a role in the new Wubb Girlz movie as a literal star.

videos.title: A Wubbstar is Born (8)
videos.overview: After becoming a movie star and starring in several movies, Wubbzy realizes that he misses his friends leaving to Wuzzleburg.

videos.title: Ty Ty the Tool Guy
videos.overview: Our 4 friends are back in Wuzzleburg after going to Wuzzlewood. Ty Ty the Tool Guy (voice of Ty Pennington) helps the gang coordinate a house-rebuilding project for the Quacker family, but soon Wubbzy, Daizy, Widget and Walden bicker over their construction method.

videos.title: Happily Ever After
videos.overview: Widget builds a machine bringing a crazy and mischievous book character called the Hopping Dipple Dop to life, who causes havoc all around Wuzzleburg on a search for his cat.

videos.title: What a Card
videos.overview: Wubbzy and Daizy befriend Earl, who just got a rare footy-football card of Touchdown Tiki. They both want the Tiki card so they keep acting nice, but arguing, to Earl.

videos.title: Too Many Wubbzys
videos.overview: Widget builds a machine where Wubbzy makes clones of himself. Unfortunately, the Wubbzy clones soon turn into wacky Wubbzy's with crazy quirks.

videos.title: Mr. Unlucky
videos.overview: Wubbzy thinks a newfound penny will bring him good luck and he wants to go home, but then he walks under a ladder, and bad luck follows.

videos.title: Focus Wubbzy
videos.overview: Wubbzy needs help to focusing. He notices the mailman in jam and he has to help. His friends get in trouble and now they need help.

videos.title: Rush Hour
videos.overview: Wubbzy enters a Floaty Boat contest, but he builds his boat too quickly and it falls apart and her sinks but his friends save him in time.

videos.title: Wubbzy's Rainy Day
videos.overview: Rainy weather ruins the gang's plans, so they devise some indoor games.

videos.title: Run for Fun
videos.overview: Wubbzy and his friends compete in the Wuzzolympic Games. Everyone cheats and not Daizy, so she soon wins.

videos.title: Woozy Walden
videos.overview: Wubbzy and Daizy try to take care of Walden when he gets sick with "Chickenitis", where Walden cannot help clucking like a chicken. Unfortunately, Wubbzy and Daizy misunderstand all of Walden's clucks and make him get worse.
